title: Les Paradis Artificiels: opium et haschisch
author: Charles Baudelaire
notes: 1860 first edition (French). Baudelaire's foundational literary study of drug-induced altered states; appended is his French adaptation of De Quincey's Confessions as 'Un Mangeur d'Opium'.

title: Confessions of an English Opium-Eater, and Suspiria de Profundis
author: Thomas De Quincey
notes: 1850 edition bound with Suspiria de Profundis, De Quincey's visionary hallucinatory sequel. First published 1821-22. Founding text of literary drug writing.

title: Histoire de ma fuite des prisons de la République de Venise
author: Giacomo Casanova
notes: Casanova's only autobiographical work published in his lifetime (Prague/Leipzig 1788, French). His own account of escaping the Leads prison of the Venetian Inquisition in 1756.

title: Mémoires de Jacques Casanova de Seingalt, Vol. 1
author: Giacomo Casanova
notes: Garnier 1871 edition (French). Volume 1 of the Mémoires that Casanova wrote in French c.1789-1798.

title: Mémoires de Jacques Casanova de Seingalt, Vol. 2
author: Giacomo Casanova
notes: Garnier 1871 edition (French). Volume 2 of the Mémoires.
